title: Pure Dragon Ruler
summary: Dragon Rulers with generic Dragon support and staples; the page's Dragon Link and Tenpai partners are left out. None of the Dragon Rulers are on the TCG banlist. Each Level 7 Ruler summons itself from the hand or GY by banishing two Dragons or monsters of its Attribute, searches a Dragon of its Attribute when banished, and discards itself with another monster for an effect. The baby Rulers summon their big Ruler from the Deck. The 2025 wave leads. Spectral, Dragon Ruler of Flickers discards itself with a Dragon or LIGHT monster to search two Dragon Rulers, and Nebulus brings back two banished Rulers of different Attributes. On top come three Rank 7 Dragon Ruler Xyz: Chasma copies a Ruler's discard effect on either turn, Eclipse summons a big Ruler and negates Spells/Traps, and Disaster banishes their monsters of the matching Attributes.
